$comment: Alternative provider (managed Kubernetes on Cloud.ru Evolution): kept validated, not the beta path (founder decision: k3s on VMs, Timeweb Cloud first). Contract of a hosting provider for tools/deploy/infra.mjs (docs/reviews/impl-notes/M2-06.md «Смена провайдера»). Everything provider-specific of the deploy lives in infra/tofu/<provider>/ and infra/helm/providers/<provider>.yaml; the envs/<env> roots must expose the outputs listed in outputs.
name: cloudru
title: Cloud.ru Evolution (managed Kubernetes)
requiredEnv: id проекта Cloud.ru окружения (GitHub variable окружения)

outputs.env: registry_url, domains {platform, systems}, network {pods_cidr, services_cidr, nodes_cidr}, postgres_cidr, db_subnet_id
outputs.postgres: map name → {id, connection_string}; key platform (prod) or main (staging)
